recruiter_direct_pitch.name: Recruiter & Hiring Manager Direct Pitch
recruiter_direct_pitch.subject: Quick question regarding {role} at {company} - {candidateName}
recruiter_direct_pitch.body:
Hi {firstName},

I noticed {company} is actively scaling its {department} team and hiring for {role}.

Given my background in {keySkills} where I recently {keyAchievement}, I believe I could make an immediate impact on your upcoming technical initiatives.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute conversation this week to discuss how my skill set aligns with your team's goals?

Best regards,
{candidateName}
{portfolioUrl}

vp_engineering_pitch.name: VP / Director of Engineering Value Pitch
vp_engineering_pitch.subject: Ideas on {company}'s {role} infrastructure - {candidateName}
vp_engineering_pitch.body:
Hi {firstName},

I've been closely following {company}'s technical roadmap and engineering blog posts.

As a specialist in {keySkills}, I recently tackled a core challenge where I {keyAchievement}. I noticed your team might be solving similar scaling constraints as you expand.

I'd welcome the chance to share a couple of specific architectural insights with you. Are you open to a brief 10-minute sync next Tuesday?

Best,
{candidateName}
{portfolioUrl}

hr_candidate_sourcing.name: HR Recruiter to Candidate Sourcing
hr_candidate_sourcing.subject: {firstName}, exciting {role} opportunity at {company}
hr_candidate_sourcing.body:
Hi {firstName},

I came across your profile and was impressed by your extensive track record in {keySkills}.

We are currently looking for a high-performing {role} to lead critical platform initiatives at {company}. Given your background, I believe this role would be a natural accelerator for your career.

Are you open to learning more about our engineering roadmap and compensation benchmarks?

Best regards,
{senderName}
{company}

executive_networking.name: Executive Peer Networking
executive_networking.subject: Connecting with {role} leaders in {industry}
executive_networking.body:
Hi {firstName},

I've been following your leadership at {company} and your work shaping {industry} standards.

I am connecting with fellow leaders to exchange insights on modern system architectures, talent retention, and AI adoption trends.

Would you be open to a 15-minute virtual coffee over Zoom in the coming weeks?

Warmly,
{senderName}

b2b_partnership_pitch.name: Business Development & Partnership
b2b_partnership_pitch.subject: Potential collaboration between {company} and {myCompany}
b2b_partnership_pitch.body:
Hi {firstName},

I've been following {company}'s impressive expansion.

At {myCompany}, we help engineering teams {valueProposition}. We recently helped a similar platform achieve {metricResult}.

Do you have 10 minutes next Wednesday for a brief introductory chat?

Best regards,
{senderName}

investor_pitch.name: Investor & Venture Pitch
investor_pitch.subject: {startupName} ({metricHighlight}) - introduction to {firstName}
investor_pitch.body:
Hi {firstName},

I'm reaching out because of your notable investments in the deep tech space.

I'm the founder of {startupName} — we {oneLiner}.

Over the last 6 months, we've achieved {metricHighlight} and are now raising our round to accelerate product development.

I've attached our one-pager and deck here: {pitchDeckUrl}.

Would you be interested in a 15-minute introductory call next week?

Best,
{founderName}

follow_up_gentle_nudge.name: Gentle Follow-Up Nudge (Day 4 - 7)
follow_up_gentle_nudge.subject: Re: Quick question regarding {role} at {company}
follow_up_gentle_nudge.body:
Hi {firstName},

I know how busy your schedule must be managing priorities at {company}.

Just wanted to briefly bump this to the top of your inbox in case it slipped through. Would you have 5 minutes to connect this week regarding the {role} role?

Best,
{senderName}

graceful_breakup.subject: Permission to close the loop — {senderName}
